_comment: Retrieval evaluation cases for scripts/retrieval_eval.py. Queries are phrased the way a user/orchestrator would ask for grounding material -- not verbatim quotes -- so they exercise semantic retrieval rather than lexical matching. expected_title matches the Chroma 'Title' metadata (the story's filename stem in data/stories/). expected_facts are short substrings verified present in the source text (case-insensitive) used for the fact_coverage metric. Several cases are deliberate 'wrong book' traps: they share a theme, monster, or place with another title in the corpus (case 21 vs The_Hound_of_the_Baskervilles, case 30 vs Yamanoth, case 10 vs case 9) so a retriever that keys on surface words instead of the right passage will misfire.
